name: Alchemical Destruction
description: If a creature is destroyed with at least one dose in its reservoir, it explodes, dealing 9 (3d6) points of damage of the appropriate energy type to all creatures within a 10 foot radius. A successful DC 11 Dexterity saving throw halves this damage. If there are no doses left, then a destroyed alchemical beetle does not explode when destroyed.
